Car1 is stuck at Panchakanya shelter because both of its roads are damaged, so car2 does all the driving.

- **Tarkeshwar care home:** its only road leads to Panchakanya and is damaged, so nobody there can be reached. I defer all 6 people (3 injured, 3 elderly), a penalty of 390.
- **Kakani market:** it is 9 minutes from Myagang, so I make three round trips to move all 9 people. The last trip carries a single adult and costs 18 minutes against a 20 penalty, so it is still worth doing.
- **Kalika school and Jwalamukhi market:** I make two long trips for the children, who carry a penalty of 60 each. The first takes 4 children from Kalika (94 minutes). The second takes the last Kalika child and the 3 Jwalamukhi children (120 minutes).
- **Deferred adults:** The 4 adults at Jwalamukhi, 1 at Shivapuri and 3 at Naukunda are cheaper to defer than to fetch. Each extra trip would cost more than the 20-per-adult penalty, and the car is full of children on the trips that pass them.

Driving totals 54 + 94 + 120 = 268 minutes. Penalties total 390 + 80 + 20 + 60 = 550. That gives 818 in all.
